candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. E no dey convulse now and dem no talk say e don get convulsion before. The pikin no dey lethargic or unconscious. E dey able to drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. No blood dey inside e stool. When I check, e dey drink poorly. The pikin eyes dey sunken. E no dey restless or irritable. When I pinch the skin, e skin dey normal. E no get cough or any wahala for breathing. E get ear problem. Dem no talk say ear discharge dey and no pus dey drain from ear. E no dey complain of ear pain. E get tender swelling behind e ear. E no get fever.
